channel.title: ArchDioramas Guides
channel.description: Diorama and miniature guides from ArchDioramas

item.title: Diorama Scales Explained: 1:12, 1:20, 1:24, 1:35, 1:50, 1:87 and More
item.description: What diorama and model scales mean, how big a person, door or brick is at each scale, and how to choose the right scale for your first build.

item.title: How to Make a Diorama: A Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
item.description: Build your first diorama from plan to finished scene: choosing a scale, making the base, walls and details, painting, weathering and lighting.

item.title: How to Make Miniature Bricks for Dioramas (5 Methods)
item.description: Five ways to make realistic miniature brick walls for dioramas and models: engraved foam, printed texture, laser-engraved MDF, 3D-printed sheets and real clay bricks.

item.title: Laser-Cut vs 3D-Printed Diorama Parts: Which Should You Use?
item.description: A practical comparison of laser cutting and 3D printing for dioramas and architectural models: which parts suit each, materials, file formats and safety.
